title: Frühlingstraße, Ismaning
description: Enjoy this spacious, fully furnished three bedroom apartment in a two-family house at the end of a cul-de-sac. The quiet and green neighborhood invites for long walks, running, cycling or swimming in the nearby (hundred meters) lake. You can park for free right in front of the front door. In fifteen minutes walking distance, you will find most of the things you need: a grocery store, bakeries, restaurants, a public pool with saunas and the train station. The local strain will take you to the airport in only thirteen minutes and to Munich center (Marienplatz) in twenty-five minutes.
